questions.question: What is found in the cinema after the Earthworm Man 3 showing?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: corpses of three high school boys were found in the theatre by the staff

questions.question: How did the three boys die, per the autopsy?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: all three of them died from increased pressure to the brain and asphyxia due to severe cranial deformation

questions.question: Why does Gojo place Yuji on Nanami's missions?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Satoru Gojo entrusts him to join grade 1 sorcerer Nanami on tough missions, as a means of advancing his protege's abilities

questions.question: What is Yuji and Nanami's first assignment?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Their very first assignment is to investigate the mysterious deaths by disfiguration that occurred in Kawasaki City

questions.question: What does Nanami tell Yuji he needs to learn to see?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Nanami teaches Yuji that he needs to learn to see the residuals left behind by the cursed techniques

questions.question: What does Nanami teach Yuji about his own cursed technique?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Nanami divulges the rules of his cursed technique and teaches Yuji that doing so makes it more powerful

questions.question: How does Nanami defeat the first curse?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Nanami chops off all the curse's legs and defeats it

questions.question: What property of Yuji's cursed energy does Gojo's training reveal?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Yuji discovered his cursed energy has a time lag

questions.question: What does the time lag do to Yuji's strikes?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: This allows his strikes to have the impact of two hits

questions.question: What is the name of Yuji's two-hit attack?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Yuji reveals the name of his attack is Divergent Fist

questions.question: What detail on the defeated curse surprises Nanami?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Nanami takes notice of Yuji's massive potential before realizing the curse he defeated was wearing a watch

questions.question: Why does the phone photo prove the creatures are human?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: As curses can't be perceived by normal means, they shouldn't appear in a photo taken by a phone camera. However, it does, meaning these creatures are actually in fact human

questions.question: What does Shoko confirm about the creatures' cause of death?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Transfigured Humans

answer.item: Shoko discovered their cause of death was due to cellular transmogrification and not their actions
